password.text: Changing your password signs out your other devices.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.text: Sign out of every device, for example after losing a phone.

rules.title: Rules and analysis
rules.text: These settings apply to the whole business.
rules.employeeMaxDiscountPercentHelp: Above this, only a manager or the owner can give the discount.
rules.allowNegativeStockHelp: Not recommended: lets you sell more than recorded stock.
rules.salesWindowDaysHelp: Days of sales used for the average.
rules.safetyStockDaysHelp: Days of sales kept as a buffer.
rules.slowMovingDaysHelp: Period used to spot products that sell little.
rules.deadStockDaysHelp: No sales at all for this long.
rules.maxDaysOfSalesHelp: Flag an adjustment larger than N days of sales.
rules.valueThresholdHelp: Flag an adjustment worth this much or more.
rules.shareOfStockPercentHelp: Flag a removal of this share of stock or more.
rules.perUserDailyNegativeCountHelp: Flag beyond this many removals in a day.

categories.name: Name
categories.emptyText: Categories help filter products and reports.
